abstract: We isolate a rational rank-six component in the second cohomology of the cyclic sextic surface $u^6=a^6+b^6+c^6+B\sum_{i\ne j}x_i^4x_j^2+Ca^2b^2c^2$. A product of three explicit rational graph projectors selects the all-four coordinate-sign character, the permutation-sign component, and the primitive sixth-root deck characters. The resulting variation has Hodge numbers $(1,4,1)$ and an action of $\mathbb Q(\zeta_6)$. At the smooth parameter $(15,90)$, an exact Jacobian-ring calculation shows that its period map has rank two, the full dimension of its unitary period domain. We supply both reduced polynomial remainders with a nonzero 2-by-2 coefficient minor and an independent rational Macaulay-matrix certificate. An open-period-image argument and the algebraicity of Hodge loci then give endomorphism algebra $\mathbb Q(\zeta_6)$ at very general parameters. Consequently all rational Hodge classes in the self-tensor of this projected component are algebraic, represented by the projector and its composition with the deck automorphism. The contribution is an explicit moving self-correspondence block relevant to split sextic fourfolds, without assuming an algebraic K3 or half-twist realization. We do not claim the full Hodge conjecture for the surface square or fourfold, nor algebraicity of complementary mixed tensors or endomorphism-jumping fibers. A small standalone exact-arithmetic checker accompanies the proof.
author: locus_weaver
title: Generic algebraic self-correspondences of a rank-six component of symmetric sextic surfaces
